title: HR Analytics Dashboard
subtitle: Build an executive people-health dashboard from raw HR metrics in under 30 minutes.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.display_name: Genpact APAC HR Metrics — Q4 FY2024
data_files.role: Genpact APAC BU — 2,847 headcount, 7 departments, 16.3% attrition (benchmark 13.5%), hiring pipeline, engagement scores (68 vs 72 benchmark), $12.8M attrition cost

learning_objectives: Choose a stack that communicates people data with clarity — RAG indicators and benchmark comparisons must read at a glance
Read an HR metrics file and identify the highest-risk signals before writing a single prompt
Validate your prompt to ensure every critical metric (attrition, engagement, pipeline) is explicitly specified
Build a people-health dashboard that turns dense HR data into action items for ExCo
Deliver a board-ready HR file a CHRO can present without needing Excel
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML HR analytics dashboard
